verdict.rationale: The CLI documents a `skills-lock.json` lockfile: `skills install` with no arguments restores from it, and an experimental_install command does the same. Updates happen through an explicit `skills update` command, and project-scoped skills are committed with the repo and shared with the team, which gives some control over when changes land. Community complaints about missing versioning are general criticism rather than a concrete failure, so they lower confidence but do not create a dispute. Missing for 10: documented version/ref pinning syntax, a description of what the lockfile records (e.g. commit hashes) and how it gates updates, non-experimental status for the lockfile workflow, and hands-on corroboration that updates never land silently.

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, I can control when skill changes reach my team — pinned versions or a lockfile rather than silent behind-the-back updates

citations.quote: Committed with your project, shared with team
